similarityReview: The model captures the iconic massive, hollowed-out trunk of the Boab tree using a combination of ellipsoids and cylinders. The canopy is represented by multiple overlapping ellipsoids to simulate the sparse, spreading foliage characteristic of the species. The hollow cavity is represented by a dark-colored cylinder/box hybrid to create depth. The overall proportions and the rugged, bulbous nature of the trunk are well-represented.
